entry.title: David’s Bridal to spin off Pearl into stand-alone, publicly traded company
entry.summary: David’s Bridal CEO Kelly Cook is expected to become the chief executive of Pearl, which will own the wedding retailer’s intellectual property and brand.

entry.title: Beyond Yoga aims to have ‘many’ stores. They’ll probably be yellow.
entry.summary: CEO Nancy Green says the brand color is reflective of a broader focus on joy — and making progress over perfection.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: Torrid CFO exits and Belk secures financing
entry.summary: Paula Dempsey will leave the apparel retailer next month. The department store, meanwhile, will use some of its new funds for seasonal inventory.

entry.title: Bath & Body Works introduces new store concept
entry.summary: The Feel Good concept is now open in Charlotte, North Carolina, and features easy navigation and enhanced testing experiences.

entry.title: Etsy updates AI use policies to emphasize craftsmanship
entry.summary: While it’s implementing more AI, the online marketplace now requires at least one authentic, non-AI generated image in most seller listings.

entry.title: Macy’s revamps Santaland, brings back Holiday Square
entry.summary: The department store is leaning into the festive season at its Herald Square flagship in New York with a variety of activations.

entry.title: Lululemon adds former product chief to board
entry.summary: Tara Poseley, who led product at the athletics retailer from 2013 to 2015, is joining the board as part of the company’s agreement with founder Chip Wilson.

entry.title: The most expensive problems are the ones you’ve learned to live with
entry.summary: Some of retail’s biggest opportunities may be hiding inside familiar operational constraints.

entry.title: Keeping pace with Walmart Marketplace: the work behind Base.com’s Innovation Award
entry.summary: Base.com wins the Walmart Marketplace Innovation Award at Let's Grow 2026.

entry.title: Agentic commerce: The infrastructure is ready for AI agents. Is your store?
entry.summary: With the holidays approaching, check these signals to assess your AI readiness (and check it twice).
